name: digital-globe-network
description: Holographic digital globe network motion graphic - 4K Remotion compositions (Three.js / WebGL2 shaders)

scripts.render:v1: remotion render DigitalGlobe-V1-Reference "out/Version 1 - Digital Globe Network - Reference Match (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render DigitalGlobe-V2-OrbitCamera "out/Version 2 - Digital Globe Network - Orbit Camera (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
scripts.render:v1:4k: remotion render DigitalGlobe-V1-Reference "out/Version 1 - Digital Globe Network - Reference Match (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:v2:4k: remotion render DigitalGlobe-V2-OrbitCamera "out/Version 2 - Digital Globe Network - Orbit Camera (4K).mp4"
